purpose: Independent practice of F1.1 exact change.
student_learning_goal: I can calculate exact change for whole-dollar transactions.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can calculate exact change for whole-dollar transactions.
header.character_watermark: Budget Bea the Bear in the top-right with a calculator. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 transactions, calculate exact change with subtraction.
parts.visual_layout: Four transaction boxes with subtraction layout.
